def factor_cycle_dominance_smoothed(df):
    """Smoothed overnight-vs-intraday cycle dominance without volume modifier."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    window = 120
    spread = overnight_ret - intraday_ret
    rolling_sum_spread = spread.rolling(window, min_periods=1).sum()
    rolling_std_spread = spread.rolling(window, min_periods=1).std(ddof=1)
    factor = rolling_sum_spread / (rolling_std_spread.replace(0.0, np.nan) * np.sqrt(window))
    factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    df_copy["factor_cycle_dominance_smoothed"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_cycle_dominance_smoothed"]
description: Mutation preserves the core overnight-vs-intraday cycle dominance mechanism from the parent crossover factor and its qualified ancestor alpha-market-cycle-0-2. The parent strength target is ICIR/RankICIR stability of the cycle signal. The bottleneck is the noisy volume-confidence modifier inherited from alpha-drawdown-volume-confirm-002, which can distort cross-sectional ranking. The modifier is removed. Normalization is changed from total absolute returns to a rolling t-stat of the overnight-minus-intraday spread, smoothing volatility scale and reducing amplitude sensitivity to target RankIC without harming ICIR. Cross-sectional transform remains none because the raw payoff mechanism is preserved.
